corrections.text: The article gives the NATS due diligence document's figures (two organizations at 67% of contributions, six contributors at 55%, Synadia at 50.39%) without their window, while giving the KubeVirt window. The NATS document gives them as LFX Insights figures for the past 365 days (link range 2025-09-29 to 2026-09-29) and does not say what quantity the 50.39% measures; the KubeVirt document's 'about 91%' is Red Hat's share of 71,874 contribution activities for 2025-10-01 to 2026-10-01. The two shares come from different windows and are not necessarily like-for-like measures.

The article says Derek Collison replied 'in a blog post quoted by The Register'. The cited Register page (April 28, 2025) says only that Collison 'replied' and 'said' the quoted words; it does not say the reply was a blog post. The quotation, 'primarily funded, supported, and maintained by Synadia', is verbatim from the Register page.
